title: RNA-seq of primary human bone marrow derived mesenchymal stromal cells from pediatric B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) patients
description: To investigate the identity of the tumor microenvironment in acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL), the transcriptome of mesenchymal stromal cells derived from bone marrow of three pediatric patients at the onset of the disease was analyzed and compared with its normal counterpart.

samples.title: 20190607_S11
samples.description: Protocols: Bone marrow specimens were obtained through BM aspiration from 3 pediatric B-ALL patients referred to the IMSS Specialties Hospital (Puebla, Mexico) before any treatment. Healthy BM sample was obtained from one healthy pediatric patient undergoing minor orthopedic surgery. Mononuclear cells (MNC) were obtained by Ficoll-Paque density gradient centrifugation and then 2–4 millions were placed in culture with low glucose Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s medium (DMEM, Gibco) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS, Gibco) and 100 U/ml of penicillin/streptomycin (Gibco). Mesenchymal stromal cells (MSC) were then isolated by their plastic adherence properties. Upon confluence, cell monolayers were trypsinized and reseeded for their expansion and biological characterization for at least one more week. Immunophenotype of MSC was confirmed by flow cytometry as CD45−CD34−HLA-DR−CD90+CD73+CD105+. RNA-seq were performed with harvested cells from the third passage. The nomenclature on the files is composed by the letter D (which refers to the 2D condition in which cells were cultured – same for all samples), along with the letter A, B, or C to indicate each technical replicate. There are three technical replicates for each experimental condition as follows: - (NBM) 2D A, B, C; - (ALL1) 2D A, B, C; - (ALL2) 2D A, B, C; - (ALL3) 2D A, B, C. NBM refers to control condition and ALL refers to leukemia samples. No treatment was applied in this study. RNA was extracted from 500,000 MSC according to manufacturer (RNeasy kit, QIAGEN, MX) and RIN>8 were confirmed in the samples. Libraries were constructed by using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit according to manufacturer (Illumina, CA, USA).
